summary: Backend-only verification of new POST /api/auth/google endpoint + regression smoke for surrounding auth & admin endpoints. 15/15 pytest tests PASSED (3.26s) against the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. The Google endpoint correctly maps Emergent upstream 404 -> 401, returns 400 for empty/whitespace session_id, 422 for absent required field, and accepts both null and absent referrer_id. OAuth-only accounts (password_hash='') are correctly rejected at /auth/login with 400 'Invalid credentials' (verified by inserting a fake OAuth user directly into Mongo). All existing auth endpoints (signup, login, demo-login, forgot-password, reset-password, /auth/me) and admin endpoints (/admin/summary, /admin/reports, /admin/users/{id}/moderation) still respond correctly. Full E2E Google flow was intentionally skipped (requires real browser/Google account).
critical_code_review_comments: auth_google endpoint cleanly reuses make_token + _safe_user — JWT contract matches /auth/login.
Email match uses case-insensitive regex with re.escape(email) — safe against regex injection.
Username collision suffixing capped at n>50 with random 4-digit fallback — bounded loop, good.
Referrer self-link guard (body.referrer_id != user.id) prevents self-referral, but is largely moot for brand-new users (uuid never matches an inbound id) — fine to keep as defensive.
Suspended-user check inside the existing-account branch swallows ValueError/TypeError silently (matches pattern used in /auth/login) — consistent.
Upstream httpx call uses 15s timeout — reasonable for a sign-in path.
seed_data_creation: Tests create throwaway signup users (prefixed oauthsmoke*, resetsmoke*, oauthonly*) and clean up the OAuth-only fake (mongo delete_one in finally). Signup users are left in DB by design (no /auth/delete-user endpoint) — same pattern as existing test files.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_google_oauth.py covers the /api/auth/google contract end-to-end except the success path (which requires a valid Emergent session_id from a live Google sign-in). If you need to exercise the success path later, mock httpx.AsyncClient.get at the module level or run inside a Playwright session that hits auth.emergentagent.com. The session_id Emergent issues is single-use — capture it from the redirect fragment and POST immediately.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects found. Endpoint behaves to spec.
